name: Custom Tailoring
shortDescription: Made-to-measure clothing cut from your own measurements, fabric choice and fit preferences.
highlights: Full consultation, measurement and fabric selection
Two fitting sessions before final delivery
House pattern kept on file for future orders
Suits, occasion wear, traditional outfits and everyday staples
body: Custom tailoring is the heart of Lipek Fashion. Every piece starts with a conversation about how you live in your clothes, not just how they should look on a hanger.
We take a full set of measurements, walk you through fabric and lining options, and cut a first pattern that's fitted on your body across two sessions before final delivery.
Explore our tailoring categories below, from formal suiting to traditional and African-print occasion wear.

seo.title: Custom Tailoring
seo.description: Made-to-measure suits, occasion wear and everyday clothing, cut and fitted by hand at Lipek Fashion.
